card.name: Verb after 'and' in warning sentences
card.fires_on: The word 'increases' (or 'increased', 'Known') right after 'and' in warning text. It is strongest in the pregnancy warning about renin-angiotensin drugs and fetal renal function.

modes.label: Pregnancy warning
modes.description: 'increases' after 'reduces fetal renal function and' in the renin-angiotensin pregnancy warning.
modes.example: D Use of drugs that act on the renin-angiotensin system during the second and third trimesters of pregnancy reduces fetal renal function and<< increases>> fetal and neonatal morbidity and death

modes.label: Other warning phrases
modes.description: A word such as 'increased' or 'Known' after 'and', 'an' or a list number in contraindication or risk text.
modes.example: 4 ) Acute or severe bronchial asthma in an unmonitored setting or in absence of resuscitative equipment. ( 4 )<< Known>> or suspected gastrointestinal obstruction, including paraly
